blind.description: A low, square stone or metallic post/bollard with a slightly tapered shaft. Each vertical face features an inset rectangular panel. Near the top, a contrasting reddish-terracotta band wraps around the shaft, beneath a bevelled, domed capstone fitted with a small bronze/metallic circular stud at the center. Geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with no hovering elements, holes, or fused anomalies.
blind.from_above: A square with rounded corners and a bevelled edge, centered on a small circular bronze stud.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 feet tall (around one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 10 to 12 inches wide at the base.
